name: Conceptual Sketch
what_it_means: Conceptual Sketch design looks like a designer's notebook or whiteboard: hand-drawn wobbly boxes, wireframe placeholders, pencil annotations, arrows and grid paper. It signals thinking-in progress and creativity, and is popular for tools, agencies and educational content.
best_for: Design tools, whiteboard apps, agencies, tutorials, pitch pages
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a landing page for [CREATIVE TOOL] in a Conceptual Sketch style, as if drawn in a designer's notebook. Off-white dot-grid paper background (#FBFAF5). All boxes, buttons and cards use hand-drawn wobbly borders (irregular border-radius like 255px 15px 225px 15px / 15px 225px 15px 255px) in ink black. Image placeholders are wireframe boxes with an X. Add handwritten annotations in blue pencil (#2B4C7E) with curved arrows pointing at features, yellow highlighter marks (#FFE45E) behind key words, and a red circled callout (#E85D4A). Fonts: Caveat / Architects Daughter.
